_comment: Watched services for scripts/update_lists.py. 'routing: true' services also get a lists/custom/<key>.lst domain list that SmartRoute actually routes on (used for services genuinely missing from Xray's geosite database). Every service (routing true or false) gets a lists/ip/<key>.lst resolved-IP snapshot for reference/allowlisting -- NOT used for routing itself, since CDN-backed services rotate IPs constantly and a periodic DNS snapshot is inherently incomplete. Add candidates over time; dead ones drop out automatically.

youtube.label: YouTube (already in geosite -- IP snapshot is informational only)

discord.label: Discord (already in geosite -- IP snapshot is informational only)

claude.label: Claude / Anthropic (already in geosite as 'anthropic' -- IP snapshot is informational only)
